references.text: Direct narrative connection: 41:28 confirms that the dreams in chapter 40 (including the cup) were a precursor to God's revelation.
Fulfillment of prophecy: 40:21 shows the actual event that the dream in 40:11 predicted.
Narrative parallel: 40:17 is the second half of the same dream sequence as 40:11 and highlights the contrast in God's judgment.
Theological view of the whole: 45:8 interprets the entire story (including the cup dream) as part of God's plan of salvation.
